templates.name: AccountSecurity
templates.summary: Changing the password, turning two-step verification on and off, the devices signed in, each with Sign out, and deleting the account.

templates.name: ActivityLog
templates.summary: What people did in a workspace, newest first: who, what and when, with a search, a type filter, more on request and an export. It's the record an admin checks after something changes.

templates.name: ApiKeys
templates.summary: The keys a workspace's scripts and tools use: what each may do, when it was last used, making a new one that's shown once, and revoking one after asking.

templates.name: Billing
templates.summary: The plan with what it costs and the day it renews, how much of it is used, how it's paid (a card, a direct debit or an e-wallet), past invoices, and a cancel that takes no more steps than signing up did.

templates.name: ConsentBanner
templates.summary: Asks once whether optional cookies may be set, with accepting and rejecting one click each, and lets the answer be changed at any time. It sits at the top of the page, in the flow, so it never covers what someone is reading or the control they're on.

templates.name: Dashboard
templates.summary: The page an account lands on: the key numbers for the month, how much of the plan is used, the latest projects and what the team did. It shows skeletons while the data loads, and a first-run state before there's anything to count.

templates.name: DataImport
templates.summary: Bringing records in from a spreadsheet: choose a CSV file, match its columns to the app's fields, check every row before anything is saved, then see what was added, updated and skipped.

templates.name: DetailPage
templates.summary: One thing, here a project: where it sits, its name and details, its parts in tabs, small removals you can undo, and a delete you can't, behind typing its name.

templates.name: ErrorPages
templates.summary: Four pages for when the page someone asked for can't be shown: not found (404), offline, a server error (500) and no access (403). Each says what happened, says what to do about it without blaming anyone, and leaves a way back.

templates.name: HelpCenter
templates.summary: The topics people come for, the common questions with a search, and a way to write to a person that says when they'll answer.

templates.name: Integrations
templates.summary: The other apps a workspace can connect: which are connected, connecting one, and disconnecting one after asking. It's the page an admin opens to make your app work with the tools their team already uses.

templates.name: ListDetail
templates.summary: A list of things beside the one that's open, like messages in an inbox: two panes on a wide screen, one at a time on a phone.

templates.name: ListSearch
templates.summary: A page of rows to search, filter, sort, select and page through, with the view kept in the address so Back, a reload and a shared link all show the same list.

templates.name: MultiStepForm
templates.summary: A long form split into short steps: here an application for a business account, with three steps of questions, then every answer shown before anything is sent, then what happens next. It's built on Stepper and its `useSteps` hook.

templates.name: Notifications
templates.summary: A bell in the Navbar that opens the latest notifications in a drawer, and a full inbox page with a filter, Mark as read and Mark all as read. Both read the same list.

templates.name: Onboarding
templates.summary: The first page a new account sees: a welcome, a checklist of setup steps with how far along it is, and an empty project list that says what to do first. Progress is kept between visits, so nobody does a step twice.

templates.name: PasswordReset
templates.summary: Getting back into an account after forgetting its password: an email with a link, then a new password chosen from that link. It's where Sign in's "Forgot your password?" leads.

templates.name: SessionTimeout
templates.summary: Warns well before a signed-in session ends, lets one action keep it going, and loses nothing typed if it ends anyway.

templates.name: SettingsForm
templates.summary: A settings page made of sections, each with its own Save, its own errors and its own status, that asks before unsaved changes are lost.

templates.name: SignIn
templates.summary: An email and a password, then a one-time code, as one page. It meets WCAG 2.2's accessible authentication (3.3.8): nothing to remember or work out beyond the password itself.

templates.name: SignUp
templates.summary: A new account in two short steps: name, email, an optional phone, a password and the terms, then a code from the email to show it's theirs.

templates.name: TeamMembers
templates.summary: Who is on a team and what each person may do: change a role in place, invite people by email, resend or revoke an invite, and remove someone with Undo.

templates.name: AIChat
templates.summary: A conversation with an assistant whose replies stream in: suggested prompts to start, Stop while a reply arrives, and Copy and Regenerate once it's whole. It's built from Chat, ChatMessage, ChatComposer, CopyButton and Button.

templates.name: ActivityFeed
templates.summary: Who did what and when, newest first, with Load more at the end. It's built from Timeline, Avatar, RelativeTime and LoadMore.

templates.name: AuthCard
templates.summary: The sign-in card from the [Sign-in pattern](?path=/docs/patterns-sign-in--docs), as a block you place on your own page: email and password, then a one-time code, then signed in. The pattern is this card on a page of its own, so the two share one piece of code. It meets WCAG 2.2's accessible authentication (3.3.8).

templates.name: CartSummary
templates.summary: What's in the cart, with a quantity and Remove for each item, a coupon, and the sums down to the total, before people check out. It's built from NumberInput, Input with an Apply action, DescriptionList, Button and Toast.

templates.name: EmptyStates
templates.summary: The four empty states most apps need. Each one says what happened in words and offers the next step as a real button or link. They're built from EmptyState.

templates.name: Faq
templates.summary: Questions and answers in groups, with a search field and "Still stuck?" at the end. It's built from Accordion, SearchInput and Highlight.

templates.name: Footer
templates.summary: The site's footer: link groups, a language picker, a theme picker and the legal line. It's built from Heading, Link, Field, Select and Button.

templates.name: PageHeader
templates.summary: The top of a page inside an app: where the page is, what it's called, what it's for, and what you can do there.

templates.name: Pricing
templates.summary: Plans side by side, billed monthly or yearly. Each plan says what it includes and has one clear action. It's built from Card, SegmentedControl, Badge and Button.

templates.name: ProductGrid
templates.summary: Product cards in a grid that fits the screen, for a shop's category, search or "new this week" page. Each card has a picture, the name as the link to the product, the price, the rating and Add to cart. It's built from Card, Image, Heading, Link, Badge, Rating, Button and Toast.

templates.name: SettingsSection
templates.summary: One group of settings with its own heading, its own Save, its own status and its own error summary. A settings page stacks several.

templates.name: StatsRow
templates.summary: A row of key numbers for the top of a dashboard. Each number shows how it changed, in words as well as color, and can have a trend line.

templates.name: TableToolbar
templates.summary: The controls above a table: a search field, filters, a count of the results, and actions for the selected rows.
